user.title: HA Thermo
user.description: Choose the thermostats to manage. You can rename zones, add temperature sensors and change the limits later from the options.

init.title: HA Thermo options
init.description: Configure the automatic control or manage the zones.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Hold and reassert behaviour. Default temperatures are used when the predefined profiles are created.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Add, edit or remove a zone.

zone_add.title: Add zone
zone_add.description: A zone is one thermostat and, optionally, a dedicated room temperature sensor.

zone_edit.title: Edit zone
zone_edit.description: The internal zone id is preserved, so profiles and activators keep working.

error.zone_duplicate_climate: This thermostat is already used by another zone.
error.zone_invalid_limits: The maximum temperature must be greater than the minimum.

set_profile.name: Set profile
set_profile.description: Activate a profile on all zones or on a selection.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile id or name, or __auto__ to follow activators.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone ids or climate entity ids. Empty means all zones.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Optional hold in minutes or HH:MM.

start_bypass.name: Start bypass
start_bypass.description: Temporarily override the target. Without temperature/offset the current target is frozen.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone ids or climate entity ids. Empty means all zones.

source.name: Source
source.description: Optional label for the origin of the bypass.

stop_bypass.name: Stop bypass
stop_bypass.description: Cancel active bypasses, optionally only for some zones.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone ids or climate entity ids. Empty means all zones.

set_temperature.name: Set temperature
set_temperature.description: Temporarily set an absolute temperature using a bypass.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone ids or climate entity ids. Empty means all zones.

enable.name: Enable control
enable.description: Enable or disable automatic control globally or per zone.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone ids or climate entity ids. Empty means all zones.

create_profile.name: Create profile
create_profile.description: Create a profile from a full profile object.

update_profile.name: Update profile
update_profile.description: Update an existing profile from a full profile object.

delete_profile.name: Delete profile
delete_profile.description: Delete a profile and the activators that reference it.

clone_profile.name: Clone profile
clone_profile.description: Create an independent copy of a profile, optionally limited to some zones.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone ids to copy. Empty means all zones.

create_activator.name: Create activator
create_activator.description: Create an activator from a full activator object.

update_activator.name: Update activator
update_activator.description: Update an existing activator from a full activator object.
